dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white spotting and partial bars visible on the lower wing coverts against a dark grey background; boundaries are sharp and distinct.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent white edges and subterminal spots on dark primary and secondary feathers with high boundary sharpness.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Irregular ovoid reddish-brown patch covering the crown and extending to the upper nape area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct boundary between the reddish-brown crown and the uniform grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent, alternating high-contrast black and white horizontal banding across the entire visible length of the rectrices.
